faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about getting started with GrowLokal.

questions.q: What is GrowLokal and how does it help my store?
questions.a: GrowLokal is an autonomous AI marketing platform built specifically for South Indian local businesses (clinics, salons, stores, restaurants, gyms). It manages your Google Maps ranking, writes weekly posts and festive offers in Telugu, Tamil, Kannada, and English, replies to customer reviews in seconds, and responds to WhatsApp customer enquiries 24/7.

questions.q: Do I need technical skills or a computer to use it?
questions.a: Not at all! Everything is managed through WhatsApp. When our AI generates a Google post or review reply, it sends you a preview on WhatsApp. You just tap 'APPROVE' or reply 'YES' and it gets published automatically.

GrowLokal natively understands and writes content in Telugu (తెలుగు), Tamil (தமிழ்), Kannada (ಕನ್ನಡ), and English. It understands local cultural nuances, regional festivals, and customer colloquialisms.

questions.q: How fast will I see results on Google Maps?
questions.a: Most local businesses see improved keyword ranking and an increase in Google search impressions within 14 to 30 days of consistent posting, profile optimization, and 100% review reply rates.

questions.q: Is there any long-term contract or setup fee?
questions.a: Zero setup fees and zero lock-in contracts. You can subscribe monthly or save 20% with annual billing. You can upgrade, downgrade, or cancel anytime with one click.
Simply run your free 30-second Google Business Profile Audit on this page. We'll analyze your current score and send your personalized growth roadmap directly to your WhatsApp.
